name: cEOS Lab Demo
what_it_is: A Makefile-driven Docker lab that spins up three Arista cEOS container switches in a triangle topology pre-configured with EBGP. It demonstrates containerized EOS management via eAPI, SSH, NETCONF, and gNMI on a single host.
components: OOB Docker network — out-of-band management plane
net1 Docker network — ceos1 ↔ ceos2 link
net2 Docker network — ceos2 ↔ ceos3 link
net3 Docker network — ceos3 ↔ ceos1 link
Makefile — sole automation layer (make up / make down / make ceosN-cli)
protocols: EBGP (External BGP) — primary data-plane routing protocol demonstrated
eAPI (Arista HTTP JSON-RPC) — exposed on ports 6031–6033 mapped from container port 6030
SSH — management CLI access on host ports 2001–2003
NETCONF — available via EOS but not explicitly configured in demo
gNMI — available via EOS but not explicitly configured in demo
measurement: BGP adjacency state readable via EOS 'show bgp summary' CLI command
No streaming telemetry (gNMI Subscribe) configuration included in the demo
No pre-built dashboards or TSDB integrations present
configuration: Startup configs mounted as host volumes into /mnt/flash/startup-config on each container
EBGP configs stored in startup-config/ebgp/ceos1, ceos2, ceos3
Environment variables set at container launch: INTFTYPE=eth, ETBA=1, SKIP_ZEROTOUCH_BARRIER_IN_SYSDBINIT=1, CEOS=1, EOS_PLATFORM=ceoslab, container=docker
All containers run in Docker privileged mode
120-second startup delay baked into 'make up' before topology is usable
modes: up — deploys all three cEOS containers and four Docker networks via 'make up'
down — tears down all containers and networks via 'make down'
CLI access — interactive EOS CLI via 'make ceosN-cli' (docker exec + Cli)
constraints: Requires manual download of cEOS-lab-4.23.3M.tar.xz from Arista (login-gated; not publicly downloadable)
Image version is pinned to ceosimage:4.23.3M — no version flexibility without editing Makefile
All containers require Docker privileged mode
120-second mandatory wait after 'make up' before containers are ready
No docker-compose.yml present — topology is managed entirely through a hand-written Makefile
docker_services: ceos1 — image: ceosimage:4.23.3M, SSH 2001→22, eAPI 6031→6030, privileged
ceos2 — image: ceosimage:4.23.3M, SSH 2002→22, eAPI 6032→6030, privileged
ceos3 — image: ceosimage:4.23.3M, SSH 2003→22, eAPI 6033→6030, privileged
notable_absences: No fault injection or link-failure simulation
No telemetry streaming or gNMI Subscribe configuration
No NETCONF example scripts or playbooks
No redundancy or HA topology variants
No CI/CD or automated test harness
cEOS image must be sourced externally from Arista portal (not bundled)
